hero.claim: Naturally aspirated mid-engine. 340 hp. P3 Yellow.

parrafos: The Porsche Cayman 981 GTS is one of the best balanced sports cars in Porsche's modern range. Mid-engine, 3.4-litre flat-six, fully naturally aspirated character and 340 hp sent to the rear axle through the PDK gearbox.

This car, in P3 Yellow with a black leather and Alcantara interior, comes from the Spanish market and has covered 51,157 km with its original and complete service book, including four services documented at Porsche Centre and Valentin Motors.
intro.cita: A sports car built to be driven: precise, vocal, balanced. Versatile without giving up the character that defines Porsche's GTS models.

parrafos: The 3.4-litre flat-six of the Cayman GTS does not rely on forced induction to create emotion. Its character is fully naturally aspirated: a direct response from mid revs, gaining resolve and sound as the engine is stretched, with the best of the delivery above 4,000 rpm.

The PDK gearbox handles the 340 hp with millimetric precision, allowing fast shifts in Sport mode or smooth progress in everyday use. Drive is to the rear wheels, reinforcing the connection between driver and chassis.

exterior.texto: P3 Yellow turns this Cayman into a direct visual statement. The GTS specification adds darkened headlights, black multi-spoke wheels, red brake calipers and a black rear diffuser to the body colour, building a whole of maximum contrast and sporting presence. Body verified accident-free.

interior.editorial: The GTS cabin combines black leather and Alcantara with contrast stitching. The sports seats with GTS lettering, the steering wheel with PDK paddles and the Sport Chrono make up a compact, technical, driver-focused cockpit.

hitos.cuerpo: Registered in Spain on 18 June 2015. Spanish market. Factory GTS configuration in P3 Yellow with a black leather and Alcantara interior.
The car completes its first two services at a Porsche Centre, with the maintenance book correctly stamped on both occasions.
Third documented service at a Porsche Centre. Complete history with official stamp.

hitos.titulo: Major service with spark plugs at Valentin Motors
hitos.cuerpo: Major service carried out at Valentin Motors, including replacement of the spark plugs. The car is presented serviced and ready to hand over.

opinion.bio: More than 25 years of experience with collector Porsche and high-end sports cars. Hundreds of transactions overseen, with particular attention to GTS models and special editions.
opinion.intro: "On the road, the 981 Cayman GTS feels like a very precise sports car that is still easy to drive quickly."
parrafos: The chassis is very balanced: it goes where you point the wheel and stays composed even at a good pace. The responses are progressive, never abrupt, and that builds a confidence that invites you to push on. What defines this car is not speed but the quality of the information it gives you.

The naturally aspirated engine has a character a turbo cannot replicate: linear response, revs that climb with intent, and a sound that stays present through the acceleration. It is an engine you have to take to the revs. Above 4,000 rpm the car transforms.

This car also has the ideal history: four documented services, three at an official Porsche Centre and the last one at Valentin Motors. You know exactly what has been done and when. For a buyer who knows what they are looking for, that is worth a great deal.
